title: Titan’s Lakes Are Pure Methane

scenes.text: Titan’s largest lake is liquid methane, not water
Cassini’s radar mapped Ontario Lacus as a 200‑km‑wide methane basin.
Temperature near –179 °C keeps the liquid in a stable state.
These methane seas could host liquid‑methane oceans if the moon warmed up.
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Titan, Saturn’s largest moon, carries vast lakes of liquid methane. Imagine oceans of frozen gas under a blue sky. Follow for daily science!
